title: Settings
voiceCuesHint: Says Squeeze, Relax and what's next, so you can follow along with your eyes closed.
moveCheckHint: Shows when the camera sees the exercise move. It runs on your iPhone: nothing is recorded, saved or sent.
scanPhotosHint: A photo with each scan, only on this iPhone
languageHint: Change it in the Settings app.
aiConsentHint: Sends your Coach questions to the AI. Off = the Coach is unavailable.
askButtonHint: The floating button on every screen. Drag it to move it.

delete.title: Delete all data?
delete.body: This deletes your workouts, chat, face scans with their photos and settings from this iPhone. Your subscription is not affected.
